_doc: Difficulty modes, chosen on the first run (changeable in Settings). Each value is a plain multiplier applied by sim/difficulty.js; 1 = unchanged. standard is the reference the simulators were calibrated against. relaxed: income x1.15 (money from production), wavePace x1.5 (a wave every 90 s instead of 60 s, offline waves too), enemyHp x0.85, lossPenalty x0.5 (a lost wave costs half as much), freeRollInterval x0.75 (a free roll every 90 s instead of 120 s), bossTime x1.25 (150 s becomes 187.5 s). Add a mode by adding an object here; add a knob by reading it in sim/difficulty.js.

relaxed.name: Relaxed
relaxed.tagline: More forgiving: slower waves, smaller penalties, a bit more income.
